Dream 2026-11-22 linked 7 vignettes from 3 days to this record as evidence. Agree if they belong here; disagree to have a later dream drop them.

- 2026-10-25 · retells · "The flow process needs to be obvious and default" (The issue flow must be obvious and default; why did we miss it? (2026-10-25))
- 2026-10-25 · retells · "We need a standard core process that is the default that pushes work through the same flow." (A standard core process for preparing work (2026-10-25))
- 2026-10-25 · retells · "Agents should not simply bypass the flow, so there needs to be a standard interaction" (Work in a chat window is lost; one place for the flow (2026-10-25))
- 2026-10-25 · touches · "Any proposed work needs to be safely in the flow and then we can push it" (Defined as a task, tested, not lost halfway (2026-10-25))
- 2026-10-25 · touches · "we must continue this work until we know that we are following our process" (Dogfood until work is not lost; a stop for approval is a failure (2026-10-25))
- 2026-10-27 · retells · "We should make sure the we are flowing any work in through the same system." (Add our notes to the flow map and review the prepared tasks: all work flows in through the same system (2026-10-27))
- 2026-10-29 · touches · "we should be using them to run the actual work whenever possible" (Holons run their items through the ship pipelines, with code review (2026-10-29))
